description: Hercules travels far beyond Greece and confronts crises involving new pantheons, Caesar and Iolaus, with the season repeatedly testing what remains of his identity when familiar certainties disappear.

s05e01.description: Hercules and Iolaus' attempt to save Sumeria from the wrath of evil deities leads to disastrous consequences.

s05e02.description: Consumed by grief over the loss of Iolaus, Hercules attempts to bring his best friend back from the Underworld.

s05e03.description: Hercules must fight an evil female demigod sent to destroy the Druids.

s05e04.description: Autolycus and Salmoneus learn the drawbacks of stealing a magic lamp from a sultan.

s05e05.description: As Julius Caesar prepares to attack the emerald isle of Eire, Hercules aids the demigod Morrigan find the good within her.

s05e06.description: Hercules embarks on an odyssey to save the Norse god Balder from an evil prophecy.

s05e07.description: The three tragedies of Norse prophecy have occurred, and Ragnarok, the end of all things, is a certainty.

s05e08.description: A dark vision sends Herc from Eire to Sumeria, where Nebula is in danger

s05e09.description: The writers retreat to a camp and Kevin Sorbo must rescue them from a would-be murderer without revealing his true identity as Hercules.

s05e10.description: Hercules, Morrigan and Nebula return to Corinth to discover the people following the cult-like form of Iolaus, who is possessed by Dahak.

s05e11.description: Hercules and Zarathustra must exorcise Dahak from Iolaus' body.

s05e12.description: Hercules, with the help of the Amazon Ephiny, the Centaur Nagus and a youth marked for murder, must stop a volcano from destroying the people of Mount Pelion.

s05e13.description: Hercules travels to the parallel Netherworld to rescue the gods of Olympus before both worlds are destroyed.

s05e14.description: Hercules reminisces about a typical day filled with desperate villagers and derring-do with his late friend, Iolaus.

s05e15.description: In the big city of Trendopolis, Hercules and the Widow Twanky help Althea put on a fashion show. But first, they must fend off the fashion police.

s05e16.description: Morrigan joins Hercules on his mission to save the Oracle of Cyprus from predictions of her own death.

s05e17.description: Hercules returns to Cheiron's academy to stop a band of renegade cadets from taking over the school.

s05e18.description: A young Merlin enlists Hercules to save Britain from a cruel and calculating tyrant-Arthur of Camelot.

s05e19.description: The evil Discord tricks a mermaid into giving up her tail for legs.

s05e20.description: Hercules and Iolaus find a town where people are literally fading to death.

s05e21.description: Iolaus discovers to his shock that his beloved Nautica is being forced into marrying the leader of a group of thugs.

s05e22.description: Iolaus returns from the dead to warn Hercules that the end of the world is at hand.
